caseNameFull: California v. Southland Royalty Co. El Paso Natural Gas Co. v. Southland Royalty Co. and Federal Power Commission v. Southland Royalty Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 433 U. S. 907.] Motion of Federal Power Commission for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
